txt: Before you can reply he's already furiously scribbling something on the paper. When he hands the document back to you, the signature -- in upper case letters -- reads: "DON'T CALL ABIGAIL."
He hands you the bottle. "Jus' make sure to *enjoy* that one, friend!"
In this drunk's hand -- on the pipe there. Glowing blue, a mysterious, otherworldly blue. Filled to the brim with holy mysteries!
The fresh entrepreneur has forgotten your presence and is now trying to count a small number of coins in his hand.
The jolly man looks at you, then his friend in the tracksuit. "Sure I can fuckin' help. You need a signature -- I *got* you a signature."
You chat a bit with old Rosemary...
"'Bout fuckin' time, man. I've done my duty." He brings his hand up to his head for a salute.
"'Ey! Tequila! You wanna buy some speed?"
"Ah, yes, yes... the spirits." His tone cools considerably. "That'll be 300 reál."
"All kinds sir. Beer *and* wine."
"And why wouldn't they, ey? Sounds like right strong stuff."
"Are you drinking that?"
"Are you telling the story of the Headless--"
"Aye! I saw him one night when I were right shit faced!"
"Aye, 's'what I said."
"Aye, by amphetamine I mean speed."
"Aye, every word he says is true."
"Aye, good thinking."
"Aye, that was it." He gives you a thumbs up. "The spirits, real good stuff, you see!"
"Aye, that were a classic, too."
"Aye, that's the jacket you stole two weeks ago. From the kid who was making it with his gal on the beach."
"Aye, that's what I said just now... 300 reál. Don't you try to trick me, buddy-boy". He points his finger in your general direction. "Now you want it or not?!"
"Aye, the mind..." He pats his temple. "...plays tricks sometimes. Always double-check. So you want it or not?"
"Bottoms up, captain!" He hands you an ugly brown bottle.
"Bought cigarettes, bought beer, even bought a bit of speed. And look at me now... I got everyone on my hook." He spreads his arms and smiles a crooked toothless smile.
"But the idiots left me alone in there. Now, I used to teach high school biology. I *know* what doctors use to preserve dead thingies..." He gets an excited gleam in his eyes.
"Didn't stop *me* for shit, that's for sure!" His voice rings with pride. "Five lemons with half a pack of butter and you're good to go."
"Doctors are idiots, buddy-boy."
"Ey, Doom Spiral! Ain't that the jacket you stole the other week?"
"Feels like a... like a thousand fuckin' reál, man. Doing *good*."
"Feels like someone's trying to jam an angry hedgehog down your nostrils, doesn't it, buddy-boy? Wait for the adrenaline-tsunami, it's *really* great!"
"Finally came to your senses, huh, buddy-boy? Ain't nobody else gonna give you a price like that." The man starts laughing to himself. "Had to let life squeeze you to get that, huh?"
"Fuckin' 'ard work done for the day, man."
"Fuckin' cops, man, always hasslin' the poor folk." He shakes his head. "You know what? I'm keepin' the pen and that's the end of it."
"Good to see you, friend! Do I have *deals* set up for you, buddy-boy!" He spreads his arms as if wanting to embrace you.
"Good, good, good," he repeats, nodding enthusiastically. "So you want this shit or not?"
"Good-good, my man." He takes a chug from his beer bottle. "Now what can I offer ya?"
"Hell yes!" The red-nosed drunk brings his hand up to his head for a salute.
"Here you go, friend." He hands you a tiny bottle with a straw. The powder looks clotted and quite mouldy.
"Here..." He uncorks the bottle and holds it under your nose. "Be careful, it's extremely flammable. One spark and the entire city of Revachol is wiped off the map."
"Hey, Spiral-Boy, you gonna share that?" one of the other bums interjects.
"I got a freebie, when I purchased a whole carton of cigarettes." He produces a white pen with brown logos. "Smoke cigarettes, get a free pen. Deals don't come any sweeter."
"I got one of those scientific ampoules a few months ago. 'Torpedo' they call it. It's supposed to keep a man from takin' a drink." He spits a nasty yellow clot on the ground before you.
"I thought he was a cool cop."
"I'm not running tabs. It's bad for business."
"In the civilized world, it's a custom to tip the shopkeep, friend. But come back anyway." He waves you off.
"It was," he croaks. "In a week the goddamned kidneys started giving me all kinds of hell. Finally the missus took me to a private doctor's office -- not a charity, the real thing..."
"Look, opening it with my eye-socket again... No problemo."
"Mhm -- hook 'em and cook 'em, huh? You wanna buy something? Let's keep it moving."
"My kinda guy," he mumbles, handing you a pack. "Here you go, friend."
"No one's fucked me. *I* do the fucking around here."
"No, my grandma told me -- I've heard other people say it too. That it's underwater. Or, no..." He thinks. "Maybe it was the storm sewers..."
"No, my grandma' always told me his grave lays somewhere on the islets on the bay..."
"Of course, of course, of course..." The drunk raises his pilsner and nods. "It is what it is, you know? What it's always been. People, buddy-boy, it's the people."
"Oh, aye... exactly! I remember now... I remember what was so funny." He waggles the blue bottle in his hand. "Three reál, that's a *real steal* for such good stuff!"
"Oh, this is medicinal spirits. The good stuff. Got it from the doctor's office."
"Oh..." He gets a proud gleam in his eyes. "The system's been good to old Rosemary here and I'm milkin' 'er like a bitch goat in the backyard."
"Permit?" He's not really listening. "Who gives a shit? You wanna buy something? Grease the wheels, buddy-boy."
"Pfff... unhygienic. This stuff is very hygienic. Anything else?"
"Right... right..." His tone cools considerably. "As I said, that'll be 300 reál."

"See, friend..." He brings out a one-litre bottle with blue-ish liquid. The mouth is corked shut. "It's *real* valuable. Worth every reál, if you catch my drift. Got it from a bit of a business venture..."

"So whadda'ya want?" He tilts his head. "I got smokes. They're cheap. Very cheap. I got pilsner. Great deal. You won't get a better deal on that piss... Spirits I can let go for 300 reál. I also have speed. And by *speed* I mean amphetamine."
"So what do you want then?!"
"So, what's the deal, friend? Want the spirits or not?"
"Sure did, buddy-boy," he taps the side of his nose. "That's why I said amphetamine. I mean speed. I mean amphetamine. I got both."
"Sure, friend! You know it!" He points a finger-pistol at you and squeezes the trigger. "*Chck-chck*."
"Sure, friend. A bottle of high-quality spirits comin' right up, that'll be 3 reál and you're practically robbing me at this price."
"Sure-sure, friend. People are just so impatient these days. So, that'll be 3 reál from your pocket to mine. And at this price you're practically robbing me."
"Sure-sure, the spirits!" He rubs his palm against the back of his head. "Now, what did I say the price was again?"
"Swiped three cans of this blue medicinal stuff from the back room. Threw the snakes out and voilà -- what's left is this beautiful blue stuff." He shakes the bottle. "98.7%, almost pure alcohol."
"Tell 'em about the two feminists by the locks!"
"That's just life, friend."
"The fella 'ere just gave me 300 reál for a bottle of spirits! Rosemary's playin' in the big league now!"
"The idiots left me alone in there. Now, I used to teach high school biology. I *know* what doctors use to preserve dead thingies..." He gets an excited gleam in his eyes.
"The legend is here. You know the drill. Smoke up, pilsner up... buy the beautiful bottle of blue spirits. It's..." he spreads his arms, "*magic*."
"The legend returns! You know the dance. Smokable smokes. Pissable pilsner -- drink it, then convert it to piss! And there's... spirits and speed too."
"The legend returns. You know the deal, legend-man. Smokes are smokey, pilsner... gets you drunk. You've already cleaned me out of spirits... and speed." He looks sad.
"The legend! He's back. And thirsty." He nods. "I got smokes and piss and a little... speed to spice things up."
"The way she fucking goes..."
"The way she goes, buddy-boy..."
"This guy, this guy..." He says and shakes his index finger at you.
"Those assholes!" He gets visibly angry. "Those assholes charged me *four reál* to remove the damn thing. But I came out on top after all!"
"Three reál and it's yours, friend. The deal of a lifetime!"
"Three-hundred reál and it's yours, as promised." He shakes the bottle. "Best shit around!"
"Two I already sold to these fine gentlemen here," he nods at his companions. "But this last one is yours for three reál, if you want it?"
"Well, it really isn't," he croaks. "In a week the goddamned kidneys started giving me all kinds of hell. Finally the missus took me to a private doctor's office -- not a charity, the real thing..."
"What was I gonna say?"
"What?"
"Whoaaa," he gasps as he hands you the bottle. "My investment hit *big bank* this time around... Look, Doom Spiral, look!"
"Wow, you're lucky. He never lets me feel it."
"Yeah! You thought right! Don't even try to sneak anything past old Rosemary here." The man leans forward. "I got all senses locked on you, buddy-boy. So what will it be?"
"You know what's crazy, actually..." He grins, then bursts out laughing, then takes three gulps of his pilsner and stares at you intently.
"You know, it's funny, actually..." He bursts out laughing, then takes three gulps of his pilsner and stares at you intently.

"You see, friend," he raises his index finger, "man makes his own luck -- and I made mine real good. Got my hands on three bottles of *liqueur exquise*, sold two to the fellows around here and *immediately* invested the profit."
